mapper.sql: id, email, password_hash, nickname, user_level, gender, address_sido, address_sigungu, address_dong, latitude, longitude, login_fail_count, is_locked, locked_at, use_yn, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM users WHERE email = #{email} AND use_yn = 'Y'

SELECT email, nickname FROM ( SELECT email, nickname FROM users WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND (email = #{email} OR nickname = #{nickname}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN email = #{email} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET login_fail_count = login_fail_count + 1, updated_at = SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET login_fail_count = 0, updated_at = SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET is_locked = 1, locked_at = SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP), updated_at = SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE users SET address_sido = #{addressSido}, address_sigungu = #{addressSigungu}, address_dong = #{addressDong}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, updated_at = SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, login_fail_count = 0, is_locked = 0, locked_at = NULL, updated_at = SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET use_yn = 'N', updated_at = SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: /* UserDAO.findCommentNotifications */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.id AS id, c.post_id AS reviewId, r.title AS reviewTitle, u.nickname AS nickname, c.content AS content, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM post_comments c JOIN recipe_reviews r ON r.id = c.post_id JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.board_type = 'R' AND r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.user_id != #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT l.id AS id, l.review_id AS reviewId, r.title AS reviewTitle, u.nickname AS nickname, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS content, l.created_at AS createdAt FROM review_likes l JOIN recipe_reviews r ON r.id = l.review_id JOIN users u ON u.id = l.user_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.use_yn = 'Y' AND l.use_yn = 'Y' AND l.user_id != #{userId} ORDER BY l.created_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
